subject: Real compute compiler passes; exact-thread runtime local check is wrong
body: First compute_v2 matrix 83/83 PASS including actual Mali generation, semantic access manifests, atomics, high binding255/sampler31, specialization and five exact legacy package comparisons. Real planner TestFastMath nearest/linear and accumulateKernel compile with exact matching live descriptor/access manifests. All four dispatchThreads edge-region packages compile; region constants0/1/2 yield local 8x4,1x4,8x1,1x1. runtime_pipeline.inc323 compares every region package local against original requested local.width/height/depth, so it rejects the three edge regions. Please check per-region specialized local from constants/producer fields instead. My test oracle initially used plan.local too, caught this and corrected to exact region constants. Packets and producer structs gpu/build/compute-v2-producer-audit for full transport tests. This is not a compiler refusal.
